title: Form 700s – City of Berkeley Mayor and City Councilmembers (2025–present)

communications.subject: California Public Records Act Request: Form 700s – City of Berkeley Mayor and City Councilmembers (2025–present)
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the California Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Copies of all Statements of Economic Interests (Form 700) filed with the Fair Political Practices Commission from January 1, 2025 to the present by the following City of Berkeley officials, including all Annual, Assuming Office, Leaving Office, and Candidate statements and any amendments (Gov. Code §§ 81008, 87500 et seq.):

1. Adena Ishii – Mayor
2. Rashi Kesarwani – Councilmember, District 1
3. Terry Taplin – Councilmember, District 2
4. Ben Bartlett – Councilmember, District 3
5. Igor Tregub – Councilmember, District 4
6. Shoshana O'Keefe – Councilmember, District 5
7. Brent Blackaby – Councilmember, District 6
8. Cecilia Lunaparra – Councilmember, District 7
9. Mark Humbert – Councilmember, District 8

According to the City of Berkeley, these officials are 87200 filers who, as of January 1, 2025, file directly with the FPPC. If any responsive statements are already published on the FPPC Form 700 search site, please identify them by filer name, statement type, and filing date. If any portion of a statement is withheld or redacted, please cite the specific legal authority and release all reasonably segregable portions.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 calendar days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Robbie Powelson
